Length: 700 lines. Last section: "What I did not check".
about: Per-file data behind 13-upper-tests.md: every file under `tests` of store-services, store-assembly, store-request, interface-assets, interface-shell, the screens parts, control-plane, release and journey-check (plane's are in 02-test-map.md). Made 23 Nov 2026 on origin/p4-tranche at a26a8da2.

how.ownership: longest matching path over every module's files and tests (the tool's ownerOf); a row is a tracked file whose longest match is a `tests` path of the module
how.static: regex over tracked .mjs/.js: `imp` = static imports and literal dynamic imports of relative specifiers, followed transitively (latestImport); `pathHeld` = other string literals in test-side files of that closure that resolve to a tracked file or folder (a lead: the path may or may not be used at run time); `collectorCalls` = calls of declaredOpsOf/registerDeclared found in the closure
how.run: one `node --import bio-plane/test/platform-sqlite.mjs --test <the module's test files>` per module in a scratch worktree, with a preload that records per test process: modules loaded (load hook), files read or opened and folders listed through node:fs, child processes started, and counters added to eight test helpers (see the report, Method). Children's records are merged into the test file that started them.

counters.boot.door / boot.nodoor: page boots of interface-shell's harness with / without a `door` function
counters.fetch.table / fetch.frame / fetch.null /: page requests answered by the test's table / the harness's FRAME defaults / the default null answer / the door function
counters.fetch.*.viaworld: a table answer during which the world's door was called (counted only in runs made after 21:03 UTC: see notes)
counters.worlddoor: requests answered by store-request's world door
counters.worldroute: Playwright requests answered by the world's door
counters.saworld / saworld.send: worlds made by store-assembly's world.mjs / requests sent straight to the store's dispatch
counters.fx.sa / fx.plane: stores built by store-assembly's / plane's fixture.mjs
counters.cp.call: calls of control-plane's harness `call` (makeFetch in Node)
screens-entry's kit and screens-wizards' stand-in: a screen drawn with / without a world, a request answered by the test's table, an op asked of the stand-in

how.latestAnyRoute: the latest module in the order among: static imports, modules loaded at run time, files read as text at run time, folders listed at run time (run-time routes only where run.ran is true)
how.notChecked: statSync/existsSync/accessSync are not recorded; reads made inside workerd, Chromium or any non-node child are not recorded; a path built at run time and never used in the run is not seen

routesChecked.static+run: static imports; paths held as text; at run time: modules loaded, files read or opened, folders listed, child processes started
routesChecked.static only: static imports and paths held as text only (helpers, which are not run on their own, and test files with no run record)

how.shape: empty lists, empty objects, nulls and false flags are left out of each row; perTest rows are [test name (cut at 70), below, counters' change] with below one of a, a (acts only), b, c, store, workerd

notes: Counts in run.counters are for the whole test process (file); perTest[].d is the change while that test function ran.
testsRun counts test functions that ran through node:test`s test()/it(); a file that registers none this way shows 0.

fetch.*.viaworld exists only for modules run after the counter was added: screens-daily, screens-action, screens-intake, screens-inquiry, interface-shell, store-request, store-services, store-assembly, release, control-plane, journey-check.
screens-investigate/explore.test.mjs failed 1 of 15 in the instrumented module run and passed 15 of 15 when run again with the same instrumentation and twice without it.
interface-assets/assets.test.mjs failed 9 of 22: this clone is shallow and lacks the commit the test reads with git.

journey-check: the run was stopped by me after 14 minutes. 327 tests were reported, 196 passed, 128 failed; 18 of its 39 recorded test processes exited non-zero; journey-check/live.test.mjs left no record and control-plane/t51-round9-seam.test.mjs was stopped part-way, so its counters are partial. One failing file checked in a clean worktree (answer-envelope/families.test.mjs) fails there too (16 of 18: bio-plane/src/plane/register.mjs is missing at this commit).

doorClass (control-plane and journey-check test files only): D drives makeFetch (control-plane`s harness call, makeFetch( in the file`s text, or plane`s entry under workerd); P the file asks it for an address outside /api; O a real store, record or plane stands behind the door; S screens are booted in interface-shell`s page harness; B Chromium is launched; W journey-check`s source is loaded; N no door is driven, N(store) with a real store.
The instrumented runs shared the machine with other work; processMs and the wall times are not baselines.
